MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN MEDALLION (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON THIS _ 
 
 Agenda 
 
 Change in principal line of business 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to alter the provisions of the Memorandum of Association of the Company (“ Memorandum ”) to change the principal line of business of the Company in pursuance of the relevant provisions of the Companies Act, 2017, and other applicable laws. The Board was also informed that the shareholders of the Company in an extra-ordinary general meeting (“ EOGM ”) held on [●] have approved the aforesaid alteration of the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company through a special resolution. 
 
 In light of the above, the Board was informed that the Company desires to nominate Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan to act as the Company’s authorized representative to sign and submit the necessary return with the Registrar of Companies, Lahore. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved that , the Company be and is hereby authorized to alter the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company to change the principal line of business of the Company, pursuant to the special resolution of the shareholders of the Company passed at the EOGM held on [●] and the relevant provisions of the Companies Act, 2017 and other applicable laws. 
 
 Resolved further that , Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan , be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute, on behalf of the Company, all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to affect the aforementioned transactions including filing of Form 4 and Form 26, with the Registrar of Companies, Lahore and to comply with all legal requirements in this regard.
